area_basis.padding_rule: Round envelope outwards to 0.25 degrees and add 0.25 degrees on each side; retrieval envelope only, not resampling or approval of municipal geography.

proposed_metric.description: Days whose daily minimum UTCI is below 9 degrees Celsius; one cumulative total, not sum of cumulative classes.

proposed_spatial_method.description: Area-weighted mean of per-cell yearly counts over municipal polygon intersections; fractional mean days, not household exposure.
proposed_spatial_method.missingness_policy: Record valid-area coverage and missing cells; do not silently renormalize partial coverage or fill missing counts with zero. Acceptance criteria remain pending.
